# VoltixNepal - Certified Electrical Contracting & Emergency Services in Kathmandu Valley

> VoltixNepal is a professional electrical contracting service in Kathmandu Valley, Nepal, founded by lead electrician Sanjit Mishra. We provide residential and commercial electrical installation, house wiring, short circuit diagnostics, inverter/battery installation, and 24/7 emergency repair.

## Quick Facts
- **Business Name**: VoltixNepal (Electrical Services)
- **Lead Electrician / Founder**: Sanjit Mishra
- **Service Locations**: Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, and Kathmandu Valley
- **Primary Phone & WhatsApp**: +977 9825870047
- **Official Email**: voltixnepal@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://voltixnepal.com
- **Operating Hours**: 24/7 Emergency Dispatch Available

## Core Services
- **Complete House Wiring & Conduit Piping**: Concealed wiring, distribution board load balancing, earthing pits, and modular switchboard fittings for new houses and renovations.
- **24/7 Emergency Breakdown & Short Circuit Repair**: Rapid on-site fault-finding using multimeters and insulation testers to resolve tripping MCBs, phase line faults, and power blackouts.
- **Inverter & Battery Backup Setup**: Accurate wattage load sizing, pure sine wave inverter installations, and battery maintenance.
- **Distribution Board (DB) Upgrades & Shock Protection**: RCCB, ELCB, and MCB breaker installations to prevent electric shocks and equipment fires.
- **Appliance Connections**: Geyser, AC lines, water pumps, and high-load commercial equipment wiring.
